verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent service, so a published flat annual price with the renewal price stated up front is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into that walled host. No pricing or renewal content was retrieved, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.

support.subject: As a founder, registered-agent service has a published flat annual price, with the renewal price stated up front
